title: ZenithUtility | Roblox 20th Event
features:
Features!


Event Reminder Notification: Automatically triggers an in-game notification upon execution reminding you to grab the paintball gun for Year 3.

Fully Draggable UI: Modern, dark-themed interface that you can click and drag anywhere smoothly across your screen.

Dynamic Egg Scanning: Automatically locates the Eggs folder anywhere in the workspace recursively without throwing errors.

Individual Teleport Buttons: Generates a custom, dedicated button for every single egg found, supporting both single parts and models.

Smart Anti-Stuck Positioning: Teleports your character safely slightly above each target egg to prevent getting trapped.

Auto-Cleanup: Automatically destroys any old instances of the UI on re-execution to prevent overlapping frames.

Follow Prompt: Includes an embedded creator reminder to follow unbanschelp676969.

Obfuscated Code: Encoded strings and randomized variable names for clean script execution.
